summary: ChipMOS TECHNOLOGIES INC. filed a Form 6-K with exhibits (99.1–99.4) containing notices and materials for its 2026 annual general meeting of shareholders scheduled for May 26, 2026. The filing is a routine foreign private issuer report of an AGM notice only; no special-situation event (e.g., acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, tender offer, restructuring) is disclosed. The materials include a depositary's notice for ADS holders and voting instructions. This is a standard periodic disclosure with no extraordinary corporate action. Investors should monitor the meeting agenda for any future special resolutions, but the current filing is purely procedural.
